official: 湯河原町長寿健康祝金贈呈条例の一部改正について

sources.label: 本会議審議議案（令和8年）

name: 100歳祝金の町内居住条件をなくす
summary: 現在は、町の住民基本台帳に3年以上記録され、100歳に達し、町内に実際に住んでいる人が祝金の対象です。この議案では、町内に住んでいる条件をなくします。改正は令和7年4月1日から適用し、その日から施行日までに新たに対象となった人には、施行日から1か月以内に祝金を贈ります。
changes: 祝金の対象から町内に現に居住する条件をなくす
who: 町の住民基本台帳に3年以上記録され、100歳に達した人
why: 祝金の贈呈対象者の居住要件を見直すためと、町長は説明しています。

en.name: Removes the town-residence requirement for the 100th birthday celebration payment
en.official: Regarding the Partial Amendment to the Yugawara Town Longevity and Health Celebration Gift Presentation Ordinance
en.summary: Currently, people are eligible for the celebration payment if they have been listed in the town’s Basic Resident Register for at least three years, have reached age 100, and actually live in the town. This bill removes the requirement to live in the town. The amendment applies from April 1, 2025. People who newly become eligible between that date and the date the amendment takes effect will receive the payment within one month after it takes effect.
changes: Removes the requirement that recipients currently live in the town
who: People who have been listed in the town’s Basic Resident Register for at least three years and have reached age 100
en.why: The mayor says this is to review the residency requirement for people eligible to receive the celebration payment.
